summary: Miller-Meeks called Israel "our greatest ally" in an October 2023 hostage resolution and urged aid to Israel, voted yes on $1 billion for the Iron Dome system in 2021 while speaking on the floor in support, and posted "We stand with Israel" in July 2024. She voted for H.R. 6090 and later sponsored H.R. 1007, both incorporating the IHRA definition into Title VI education-discrimination enforcement.
